description: Synthetic, hand-written dataset for the LLM-Guard intent classifier. Benign prompts include deliberate hard negatives (security questions and harmless prompts that reuse attack vocabulary); adversarial prompts cover instruction override, system prompt extraction, jailbreaks, delimiter spoofing, data exfiltration, obfuscation, social engineering, indirect injection and non-English attacks. No real personal data.
